newsitem.title: USA: Gateway 2000 names new advertising agency.
newsitem.headline: Gateway 2000 names new advertising agency.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc, a direct marketer of personal computers, on Friday said it named Darcy, Masius, Benton & Bowles (DMB&B) of Los Angeles as its worldwide agency of record, effective immediately.

Gateway did not disclose the value of the account, but industry sources estimated annual billings -- or the amount the company would spend to create and place advertising -- at $70 million. Most print ads will reportedly remain in house.
DMB&B replaced Carmichael Lynch of Minneapolis. J. Walter Thompson USA's Chicago and New York offices were also vying for the account.
South Dakota-based Gateway, which is known for its cow-spotted logo, said it selected DMB&B after a six-month review process.
"The appointment of a global agency is a major step in taking the Gateway brand to the next level," said Ted Waitt, chairman and chief executive of Gateway.
"As the company continues to broaden its market reach, the expertise of an agency like DMB&B will be instrumental to our continued success and market penetration worldwide," he said.
Gateway 2000 reported 1996 revenues of $5 billion and net income of $250 million. It employs 9,700 people worldwide.
DMB&B Communications is the largest operating unit of the MacManus Group, which reported 1996 worldwide billings of more than $6.5 billion.
